items.title: Eblen Rau Interview, 1974-05-27
items.q: But up until that time we were more or less a string band. We didn't have a couple of saxophone players. That was Benji White and Monk Smith.

ctx.x: Yeah. And Benji White had a black eye, it looks like. That's right. Yeah.
Did you ever see that? Yeah. That's funny. And Monk Smith had a stupid look in his face. He was on the front row.
And my dad had his eyes closed for some reason. He was only a real kid then, and I think he must have been 16 years old.
